change_reason: V6 was registered but never implemented or run. Independent V1-V6 source, statistical, and route audits found that V5 was the first genuine free rollout and failed four gates. A development-only scalar reliability pilot and hard selector were rejected. A symmetric three-expert pilot improved V5 mean error but was worse than its no-sparse ablation. V7 therefore makes one closure-level change from V5: prefix-backtested output aggregation is evaluated with a symmetric no-sparse control, and positive paired sparse contribution is mandatory. V7 cannot support AGI and no second V7 route may replace it after validation.

development_data_disclosure.interpretation: All pilot values are target-aware development evidence and cannot count as V7 evidence. No V7 validation or test seed was simulated before this file was written.

overrides.hypothesis: On fresh episodes from the frozen four-chart synthetic family, a prefix-backtested sparse-causal/adaptive-dense/persistence consensus will have positive paired H20 value beyond an identically calibrated adaptive-dense/persistence consensus, while improving the unscaled V5 parent and persistence and remaining noninferior to strong symmetric dense controls.
overrides.claim_boundary: This is a confirmatory closure test for the incremental forecast value of one sparse causal expert in a fully observed, known-rank-one, matched-basis, same-loading synthetic family. Passing would support only that narrow controller contribution. Failure closes this sparse contribution route. Neither outcome establishes AGI, autonomous agency, open-world causal discovery, a brain mechanism, consciousness, unseen-environment transfer, or a physical CE correspondence.

normalization.method: per-chart sample standard deviation over inherited observational-train states only

closure.weight_error: mean squared normalized error across prefix leads 61 through 80 and all four charts
closure.symmetric_refit: Each controller fits its own weights by the identical inner-prefix rule and refits its learned experts through x[80].
closure.component_recursion: Each component generates one independent H20 trajectory before combination; consensus output is never fed into a component.
closure.metric: For each seed, sqrt(mean(((truth-prediction)/training_scale)^2)) over 20 leads and four charts; reported mean is arithmetic across seeds.
closure.h5_rule: prediction_H5 is exactly prediction_H20[0:5] and never affects pass/fail
leakage_contract: forecast and weight APIs accept immutable prefix arrays and fitted objects only
maximum observed state index is instrumented and must be 80
mutating x[81:101] leaves all non-oracle predictions and weights bit-identical
mutating hidden states leaves all predictions and weights bit-identical

closure_gate.failure_meaning: The sparse expert has no confirmed incremental H20 value under this registered controller and this G9-CB route closes; favorable secondary means cannot override failure.
